title.purpose: Card titles and section headings; one quiet step above body.

body.purpose: Default UI text in both Thai and English.

data.purpose: Balances, day counts, amounts, IDs, emails — anything countable or copyable.

label.purpose: Form labels, badge text, table headers, metadata.

shadows.name: ring-hairline
shadows.purpose: Resting separation for cards and surfaces — a hairline ring, not a drop shadow.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Transient overlays only: dropdowns, popovers, dialogs, toasts.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions; honor prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis action per view. Civic Indigo fill, compact h-8.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-primary, oklch(0.488 0.243 264.376)); color: var(--color-primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.05s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--color-primary, oklch(0.488 0.243 264.376)) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-ring, oklch(0.488 0.243 264.376)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.488 0.243 264.376 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: The quiet majority of actions: hairline border on paper, muted hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-background, oklch(0.985 0 0)); color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-muted, oklch(0.97 0 0)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-ring, oklch(0.488 0.243 264.376)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.488 0.243 264.376 / 0.5); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Signalled, not screamed — a rose tint, never a solid-red fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.1); color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.2); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact hairline-bordered field; indigo focus ring, no glow.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2rem; width: 100%; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-input, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-ring, oklch(0.488 0.243 264.376)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.488 0.243 264.376 / 0.5); } .ds-input:disabled { background: oklch(0.922 0 0 / 0.5); cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat surface separated by a hairline ring, not a shadow.
components.html:
คำขอลาพักผ่อน

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 0.7rem; background: var(--color-card, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--color-card-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.145 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); }

components.name: Status Badge

components.css: .ds-data { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); } .ds-data-num { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: The dependable government desk made digital: a calm, exact place where leave, travel, attendance, and official paperwork are recorded and trusted. The interface carries quiet institutional authority — not stiff, not loud, never decorative for its own sake. Civic Indigo signals competence without shouting; everything else is a near-neutral surface so the one thing that matters on any screen — where a request is and what happens next — stands out. The system rejects both the cramped legacy Thai-government look (gray-on-gray, shadow-stacked dense tables) and over-minimal sparseness that hides the data HR needs to scan. Density is tunable (compact/normal/large); depth is hairline rings and tonal layering, never drop shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Calm, trustworthy, institutional — steady, legible, unsurprising.
Civic Indigo as the single accent; everything else neutral.
Status is the most prominent thing on any workflow screen.
Flat surfaces with hairline rings; no decorative shadows.
Monospace for all numeric/tabular data (balances, day counts, IDs, emails).
Bilingual Thai/English legibility and WCAG 2.1 AA as hard constraints.
Four themes (light/dark/soft/bold) and three density modes share one token system.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Civic Indigo is the only brand color on the surface. If a screen has two competing accents, one is wrong. Status colors are a separate, semantic system and do not count as decoration.

rules.name: The No-Warm-Tint Rule
rules.body: Neutrals sit at chroma 0 (or tinted toward indigo in the soft/bold themes, never toward warm). The cream/sand/parchment body background is forbidden.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every balance, day count, amount, ID, and email renders in font-mono. Tabular figures are data, not prose; they must align and never reflow ambiguously.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No tiny uppercase tracked kicker above sections. Headings stand on their own weight and size.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px lines and one-step brightness changes. A colored border-left/border-right thicker than 1px as an accent stripe is forbidden.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat until they're transient. Shadows appear only on things that float above the page and will disappear (menus, dialogs, toasts).

dos: Do keep Civic Indigo as the only brand accent — primary actions, active state, focus rings. One accent per screen.
Do render every number, balance, day count, amount, ID, and email in font-mono.
Do draw structure with 1px hairlines and one-step brightness changes; separate cards with ring-1 ring-foreground/10.
Do keep body text at or near Ink contrast; verify ≥4.5:1 (≥3:1 for large/bold), including placeholders and muted text on tinted surfaces.
Do pair every status color with a label or icon, for color-blind users.
Do ship the full state set on every control: default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, aria-invalid.
Do honor reduced motion and the three density modes; keep transitions in the 150–250ms range.
Do keep Thai legible — sentence case, generous line-height, the Noto Sans Thai stack.
donts: Don't reproduce the cramped legacy Thai-government look: tiny gray-on-gray text, shadow-stacked dense tables, ASP.NET-era forms with no whitespace.
Don't over-minimize to the point HR can't scan dense info — whitespace serves legibility, it doesn't replace data.

Don't add consumer-SaaS decoration (gradient heroes, marketing-style cards, decorative illustrations) or generic AI-dashboard scaffolding (identical icon+number stat-card grids, tracked uppercase eyebrows, gradient accents).
Don't use a warm cream/sand/parchment background; neutrals stay at chroma 0 (or tinted toward indigo, never warm).
Don't use drop shadows on resting surfaces — shadows are only for transient overlays (menus, dialogs, toasts).
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right thicker than 1px as an accent stripe.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) or decorative glassmorphism.
Don't make destructive actions solid-red and loud — tint them (bg-destructive/10), signal don't scream.
Don't nest cards, and don't let an eyebrow or 01 / 02 / 03 marker scaffold every section.
